item.title: Amura x Bea Interiors Showroom Opening - World Red Eye
item.description: Miami, FL - March 18, 2026 - Bea Interiors Design hosted a special showroom event in collaboration with Amura, bringing together designers, collectors, and friends of the studio for an evening celebrating contemporary design and craftsmanship. Guests explored curated furniture pieces while enjoying cocktails and a live DJ set, creating an intimate gathering that blended creativity with a social atmosphere.

item.title: WRE News: Real Housewives of Miami Hits Pause as Bravo Eyes Major Reboot - World Red Eye
item.description: Miami, FL - March 19, 2026 - Production on The Real Housewives of Miami has been halted for now, with no confirmed plans for a new season, according to sources close to the series. While the show hasn’t been formally canceled, Bravo is reportedly reassessing the franchise’s direction, exploring everything from a cast shakeup to a full-scale reboot. item.title: The GFL Padel Series Pro-Am In Memory of Sean Posner - Benefiting the Miami Beach JCC & Sean Posner Padel Academy at Sunset Padel - World Red Eye
item.description: Miami, FL - March 22, 2026 - Chris Paciello, Rafi Gibly, and the entire Sunset team along with Jarrett Posner, Wayne Boich, Adam Arviv, Patrick Dovigi, Mark Groussman and Raleigh Smith hosted a fundraiser Pro Am tournament at Sunset Padel benefiting the Miami Beach JCC in support of the Sean Posner Padel Academy, in memory of the beloved Sean Posner - A Jordan Moreira Davidson initiative.
